title: Write the Zedu LinkedIn company page: tagline, About section, specialties and first 6 posts for bootcamp operators
description: No task covers Zedu's LinkedIn company page, and the site's social links still point to old 'telex' handles, so Zedu needs its own page. Programme managers and bootcamp founders, the primary audience, are most active on LinkedIn. Deliver in one Markdown file: (1) a tagline (max 120 characters) built on 'Built for Bootcamps and Learning Communities'; (2) an About section (max 2,000 characters) covering the all-in-one workspace, no per-student pricing, AI that supports educators and private cohort spaces, using only zedu.chat wording; (3) the industry, company size field guidance and up to 20 specialties keywords; (4) 6 launch posts for bootcamp operators (one each on the Starter to Pro upgrade, flat Naira pricing, cohort channels, Buzz, AI summaries and 'fewer tools'), each with a CTA link to a live zedu.chat page; (5) a source table for every claim. Don't use the unconfirmed proof points (10,000+, 98%, 3x, 40%) without a 'needs confirmation' flag, and don't mention Telex, Enterprise prices, per-student billing or named integrations. Nothing is published without team approval.
rationale: The focus is acquiring bootcamps in Nigeria and Africa, and their programme leads look for and judge tools on LinkedIn. A credible company page backs up every outreach message and ad.
reviewBlocker: The task has no delivery waiting for review.
